conclusions.nextAction: Add primary sources, submit corrections, and promote only evidence-bounded conclusions to public pages.

productContentOpportunity.audience: Readers who want a theory explored through public records, evidence boundaries, missing records and falsification tests.
productContentOpportunity.whyItSells: It gives conspiracy-minded readers a structured research path without pretending speculation is proof.
productContentOpportunity.evidenceBoundary: Speculation is not fact. Matrix Reprogrammed separates documented fact, sourced analysis, reasonable inference, speculation, unsupported claims, and missing records. Public-record convergence may support a hypothesis, but it does not prove a single hidden command structure or unlawful conduct.
productContentOpportunity.missingRecordHook: The missing-record section gives the reader a concrete investigation target.
productContentOpportunity.callToAction: Read the free theory page, then upgrade for the full source-ledger report.
